title: Proper-support direct image of a finite-Tor complex has finite Tor dimension
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be a morphism locally of finite type, and let E be an object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume E is bounded with coherent cohomology sheaves, every cohomology sheaf of E has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and E has finite Tor dimension as an object of D(f^{-1}\mathcal O_S). Then Rf_*E [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has finite Tor dimension as an object of D(\mathcal O_S): there are integers a\le b such that H^i(Rf_*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal F)=0 for every i\notin[a,b] and every \mathcal O_S-module \mathcal F.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.27.1 (Tag 08EV; label lemma-perfect-direct-image), proof, from 'Hence it suffices to show that Rf_*E has finite tor dimension' to the end (uses Tags 08EA, 08EU base change, Cohomology 08DZ variant derived pullback)

proof.text: Apply directImage_isBounded_coherent to the boundedness hypothesis after forgetting a<=b. Extract an upper cohomology bound b and coherence of every cohomology sheaf of Rf_*E. On Noetherian S, coherence implies quasi-coherence.
The proper-support lower-bound lemma supplies an integer a controlling tensor cohomology below a for every quasi-coherent test module.
The general derived-tensor upper-bound lemma applied to Rf_*E and b gives tensor cohomology vanishing above b for every test module.

Use the ordered interval [a,max(a,b)]. Below a use the lower bound; above max(a,b), hence above b, use the upper bound. Apply the quasi-coherent test criterion to the quasi-coherent direct image to extend vanishing to every module. This is HasFiniteTorDimension.

lean.statement: theorem hasFiniteTorDimension_schemeDerivedDirectImage_of_bounded_coherent_support (S : Scheme.{u₁}) [IsNoetherian S] (X : Scheme.{u₁}) (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E)) (hcoherent : ∀ i : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E)) (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E)) (hTor : HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E) : HasFiniteTorDimension S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)
